docPlacement.noSlots: No signatures are defined in the template for this document.
docPlacement.intro: Pick a preview page, enable the slot you need — and the signature appears right here. Drag it and pull the corner to adjust its position. PNG files are stored at the project level.
docPlacement.enabledTitle: Signature is active on this document
docPlacement.enableTitle: Enable — the signature will appear in the preview
docPlacement.signDateTitle: Signing date — stamped on the PDF next to the signature (12.05.2026). Clear the field to remove it.
docPlacement.moveToCurrentTitle: Move the signature to the current page ({{page}})
docPlacement.requiredAtTitle: The signature is part of the submission package: {{checkpoints}}
docPlacement.withheldTitle: The signing route hid the image until the signer approves. It appears in the document once they approve.
docPlacement.withheldShowTitle: Show the image in the document without the signer's approval
docPlacement.withheldConfirm: Show the signature image in the document without the signer's approval on the route?

optional.hint: The route author will be able to skip this signer. The signature place will stay empty
optional.required: The template requires this signature: it cannot be made optional
optional.noRights: No access: only those who send for signing can mark this
optional.unknownSlot: This signature does not go on this document at this checkpoint
optional.skipped: Not required: skipped by the author on {{date}}
optional.keptMark: The plate stays in the frozen PDF
optional.returns: Will rejoin the route when it is sent again

overlay.detachedCaption: Signed with a detached electronic signature

pdfEditor.notCompiled: The document is not compiled yet — the preview for placing the signature is unavailable. Build <0>{{docId}}</0> and come back here.

slotPanel.deleteConfirm: Delete the PNG signature “{{label}}”? The file will be removed from disk, and the slot will be turned off in all documents. The coordinates are kept — after re-uploading, the signature will be in the same place.
slotPanel.usageTitle: How many documents use this signature
slotPanel.editorButtonTitle: File, clipboard (Ctrl+V) or drag-and-drop — all in the editor
slotPanel.kindHint: A picture is placed on the PDF. A detached e-signature: a caption is printed on the PDF and the signature file (OpenPGP or CMS) is attached separately.
slotPanel.detachedExplain: The caption «Signed with a detached electronic signature» is printed on the PDF. The signature file is attached in the document: upload a ready one or sign here.

editorModal.title: Signature: {{label}}
editorModal.description: Paste an image (Ctrl+V), drag a file in, or choose one. Then, if needed, prepare the signature with the tools.
editorModal.dropPrompt: Paste an image (Ctrl+V), drag a file here
editorModal.clipboardEmpty: No image in the clipboard — copy a picture and press Ctrl+V
editorModal.bgHint: Background removed — this is an applied step (like an eraser stroke). Fine-tune below; you can undo with the ↶ arrow.
editorModal.eraseHint: Drag across the canvas to erase the extra parts. Each stroke can be undone (↶).
editorModal.magicHint: Click an area — pixels of the same color will be erased. Each click can be undone (↶).
editorModal.cropHint: Select a rectangle on the canvas and apply the crop.

mode.title: Type:
mode.hint: A caption «Signed with a detached electronic signature» is printed; the signature file is attached separately.

freeze.title: File to sign
freeze.intro: A copy of the PDF with the e-signature caption is frozen. Signatures belong to that exact file and are checked against it.
freeze.refreezeConfirm: The existing signatures belong to the old file and will be deleted. Continue?
freeze.stale: The document was rebuilt after freezing. The signatures below are no longer valid. Freeze the PDF again and sign again.
freeze.requestZipTitle: The PDF, its SHA-256 and instructions on how to sign it. Send it to the supervisor.
freeze.unfreezeConfirm: Unfreeze? The signature files of this document will be deleted.
freeze.droppedToast: Signatures for the previous file version removed: {{count}}
freeze.plateOutdated: The signers or signature positions changed after freezing: the plate in the PDF is out of date. Freeze the PDF again.

slot.needFreeze: Freeze the PDF to attach a signature.
slot.uploadTitle: Signature file: .asc, .sig (OpenPGP) or .sig, .p7s (CMS, including GOST from CryptoARM and CryptoPro). You can drop the file here.
slot.drop: Or drop a signature file here
slot.unknownKey: The signature was made with key {{keyId}}, which the Studio does not have. Upload the signer's public key (.asc) and the signature will be checked.

verdict.invalid: Signature does not match the file
verdict.outdated: Invalid: signature is for another file version
verdict.routeStale: Signature for an earlier PDF version. The route will ask to sign again after the freeze.
verdict.routeOutdated: Signature for an earlier PDF version. The route will ask to sign again.

note.key_expired: The key has expired; the signature itself is correct.
note.multiple_signers: The file has several signers; the first is shown.
note.cert_not_valid_at_signing: The certificate was not valid at signing time.
note.chain_untrusted_root: The chain does not reach a trusted root. Add the CA root certificate in Settings → Signing certificates.
note.chain_incomplete: The certificate chain is incomplete: the issuer certificate is missing.
note.chain_broken: A certificate signature in the chain does not match.
note.no_revocation_check: Revocation lists (CRL, OCSP) are not checked.
note.plate_signer_mismatch: The signature was made by someone other than the signer shown on the plate.

sign.title: Sign in the Studio
sign.noKeys: There is no signing key yet. Create an OpenPGP key: it is stored on this computer, and signing then takes one click.
sign.name: Owner name
sign.gostNote: Qualified e-signature keys on a token (CryptoPro) cannot sign here: sign the file in CryptoARM or CryptoPro and upload the signature file.

plate.title: Signer on the plate
plate.empty: The plate is printed inside the file being signed, so the signer's data is needed before freezing. Upload their certificate or public key, or type it in.
plate.fromFileTitle: The signer's public certificate (.cer, .crt, .pem) or their OpenPGP public key (.asc). The private key is not needed.

cryptopro.title: Sign with a qualified e-signature (CryptoPro)
cryptopro.buttonTitle: Sign with an enhanced qualified e-signature from a token or the CryptoPro store through the browser plug-in. The Studio freezes the PDF itself.
cryptopro.loading: Connecting to the CryptoPro Browser plug-in…
cryptopro.pick: Choose a certificate. The private key stays on the token: CryptoPro asks for the PIN and the plug-in signs in your browser.
cryptopro.note: The certificate data goes onto the plate, and the PDF is frozen again if the plate changed. The file does not leave your computer: the Studio runs locally.

step.plate: Reading the certificate for the plate…
step.sign: Sign on the token (CryptoPro may ask for the PIN)…

not-loaded.title: Could not load cadesplugin_api.js
not-loaded.hint: cryptopro.ru is unreachable. Download cadesplugin_api.js from the CryptoPro Browser plug-in page and put it into the Studio data folder: cadesplugin/cadesplugin_api.js.

no-plugin.title: The plug-in does not respond
no-plugin.hint: You need CryptoPro CSP, the CryptoPro Browser plug-in and the “CryptoPro Extension for CAdES Browser Plug-in” in Chrome or Edge. Restart the browser after installing and allow this site to use the plug-in.

no-certs.title: No suitable certificates
no-certs.hint: The personal store has no valid certificates with a private key. Insert the token or install a certificate in CryptoPro CSP.

chain.completeTitle: Downloads the CA certificates linked from the signer's certificate (a network request; the signature file goes nowhere).
chain.root: The chain ends in the root “{{subject}}”, which the Studio does not trust yet.

signSubmission.title: Sign the submission
signSubmission.description: All your signatures on the documents of this checkpoint in one go. Each signature covers exactly the PDF version you see now.
signSubmission.noKey: No key: add one in the settings
signSubmission.nothing: No signatures of yours are awaited at this checkpoint
signSubmission.willFreeze: The PDF will be frozen for signing: images and plates go onto the page
signSubmission.confirmReset: Freezing again resets signatures already made, they will have to be made again: {{names}}

dates.addTitle: A date frame appears on page {{page}}: drag it into place and pull its corner
dates.moveHereTitle: Move the date to the current page ({{page}})
dates.signedAtTitle: The day the date marks of this signature print
dates.noDate: Without a date the marks stay empty
dates.fromRoute: The date comes from the approval in the signing route
dates.esign: A signing date adds a step for an e-signature signer: approval before freezing
dates.tooSmall: The text does not fit the frame
dates.pageMissing: The document has no page {{page}}: the date will not reach the PDF
dates.limit: A signature has at most {{max}} dates

confirm.title: Save the dates?
confirm.text: These signatures will be reset: {{names}}. The document will be frozen again and they will sign the final PDF once more. Save?

packPreset.title: Template preset
packPreset.description: Signature places and date marks of this project as a version.yaml fragment of the pack. For pack authors: move it into signatures.slots of a new template version.
packPreset.empty: Nothing to copy: the document has no enabled signature places of pack slots.
packPreset.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the text in the dialog and copy it by hand
packPreset.loadFailed: Could not load the signatures or the project template. Close the dialog and try again.

yaml.header: Signature place preset for pack {{pack}}, template {{template}}, taken on version {{version}}.
yaml.hint: Move into signatures.slots of a new template version (slots with the same id). This is a patch change.

warn.customSlot: Signature {{slot}} is not from the pack: skipped.
warn.notApplicable: Slot {{slot}} does not apply to document {{doc}} (applies_to): place skipped.
warn.perAuthorShared: Slot {{slot}} is signed by every author, and {{doc}} is a shared document of a team template: place skipped.
warn.duplicate: Slot {{slot}} on document {{doc}} has different places for different authors: took the place from {{kept}}, skipped {{skipped}}.
warn.invalidPlace: The pack would not accept the place of slot {{slot}} on document {{doc}} ({{problem}}): skipped.
warn.invalidDate: The pack would not accept date mark {{index}} of slot {{slot}} on document {{doc}} ({{problem}}): skipped.
warn.tooManyDates: Slot {{slot}} on document {{doc}} has more than eight date marks: the extra ones are skipped ({{dropped}}).
